scope: Scoped live election content, official sources and affected council map journeys.
checks: Tablelands Regional council, Division 1 and Queensland pages displayed Greg English's declared result and 11 November taking-office date. Queensland portal checked at 375 CSS px.
Search/select/Open/Back restored Tablelands Regional, Gingin, Bridgetown-Greenbushes, Kempsey, Coffs Harbour, Hunters Hill and Hobart on their live council maps.

Gingin showed the resignation effective 3 November and pending replacement with no running vacancy clock. Bridgetown-Greenbushes showed the provisional 18 March 2027 date and inactive countdown at 390 CSS px.
Kempsey showed the 16 January 2027 by-election date and current roster change. NSW portal checked at 390 CSS px.
Coffs Harbour rendered five official ballot names and the election clock. Hunters Hill showed four official names in order, its source and countdown at 390 CSS px.
Victoria showed all 96 contests and 1,037 official ballot entries. The Albert Park ballot opened at 390 CSS px with no horizontal overflow.
Hobart displayed nine current officeholders and separate final councillor, Lord Mayor and Deputy Lord Mayor contests; Tasmania council search opened Hobart and restored the selection on Back.
limitations: Content and affected navigation on cloud Chromium at the recorded desktop or phone widths. No physical touch, tablet, independent external geometry or all-place browser certification.
Map journeys used search and selection. Manual polygon picking and alternate layers were outside this election-content review.
Earlier tests were retained as historical evidence. This review only records the published election and officeholder scope.
